title: Bright Yellow Classic Volkswagen Beetle
summary: A classic Volkswagen Beetle-style compact car with a bright yellow rounded body, arched roofline, bulbous front bonnet, separate rounded fenders, chrome bumpers and trim, circular headlights, and black tyres with silver hubcaps.
observations: Distinctive classic Beetle silhouette: long rounded bonnet, upright curved cabin, high arched roof, and short rear taper.
Bright yellow paint covers the body, bonnet, doors, roof, and fenders.
Front has large round headlights set into the front fenders, amber indicators on top of the fenders, and a shiny chrome bumper.
Side view shows two doors, rounded side windows, a black running board below the door, and chrome side mirrors/door handles.
Wheels have black tyres with silver hubcaps and dark wheel openings.
uncertainties: Only the front-left and left side are visible; rear details and the right side are not directly shown.
Dimensions are based on typical classic Beetle proportions because no reliable scale reference is present.
Chrome is represented with light bluish gray in the build palette rather than metallic silver.
